overview_description.description:
Maroo is a payment platform tailored for the wedding and events industry, allowing businesses to manage payments with no processing fees. It supports payment acceptance, branded invoice creation, and payments to freelancers and suppliers. A notable feature is its zero fee model, where fees can be passed onto clients. 

Trusted by over 9,000 businesses, Maroo has facilitated more than $180 million in revenue for its community of event professionals

about_short_description.short_description: Payments platform for the wedding and events industry

product.name: Maroo Payments
product.description: A payment processing platform enabling wedding and event businesses to send invoices, accept payments via credit cards and ACH transfers, and manage transactions with fee pass-through options.

product.name: Maroo Book Now Pay Later (BNPL)
product.description: A service allowing clients to pay for wedding and event services over time through installment plans offered by Maroo or partner banks.

product.name: Contract Management and Digital Signing
product.description: A tool for vendors to create, manage, and digitally sign contracts with clients and suppliers within the platform.

identifier.value: Payments to Contractors and Mass Payouts

product.name: Payments to Contractors and Mass Payouts
product.description: A feature enabling vendors to pay freelancers and contractors efficiently, including bulk payment uploads and scheduled disbursements.

product.name: Client Management and Contact Book
product.description: A centralized system for vendors to organize and manage client contacts and communication within the platform.

product.name: Custom Branding and Templates
product.description: Options for vendors to customize invoices, payment links, and communications with their own branding and reusable templates.
